title: Google's Gemini 3.0: The Most Powerful LLM Ever
description: Get a private, on-screen walkthrough of Google’s new Gemini 3.0 with Logan Kilpatrick from Google Deepmind. We vibe-code full apps, games, and product UIs in real time. You’ll see how to go from raw idea to working product in a single prompt, then iterate visually with design, features, and AI workflows.
